memory_candidates.content: When bridging a label-generic tableau foundation module (Branch/Blocking counting layer) onto a concrete calculus whose branch type is a definitional abbrev of Branch F L, no coercion layer is needed: state bridge lemmas with explicit namespace application (Branch.posTypeAt b w, not dot notation, since abbrevs resolve dot notation to List), and the only content lemma required is a membership equivalence across an eraseDups. The Finset product notation xS for a signed universe requires Mathlib.Data.Finset.Prod in the import closure.
